channel_intelligence.suno_rules: Data-backed prompt rules, updated 2026-10-12: (1) ALWAYS 'instrumental / no vocals'. (2) KEEP ENERGY CONSISTENT, no dynamic spikes - Suggested = 62% of watch hours and those sessions end the moment a track jumps. (3) NEW - NAME THE INSTRUMENT: 'smooth jazz guitar' is the search term with the best retention (74.8% of search watch time from 8 views) and guitar Shorts are the top-view set (38/25/19 views); put 'smooth jazz guitar' / 'hollow-body' literally in the prompt and title. (4) SEASON THE TITLE AND PROMPT TOGETHER (cozy autumn / late night / grey afternoon) - Late Night Paris = 1.6h from 8 views. (5) PUBLISH CADENCE BEATS STYLE LOYALTY - fresh uploads get a distribution week; never skip a Mon/Thu long. (6) VARY RUNTIME 75-120 MINUTES on longs. (7) MORNING/WORK ACTION WORDS ('coffee', 'work session', 'get things done') show up in the top Shorts titles; keep naming the action. (8) STILL WITHDRAWN - caption rules; no evidence. (9) Thumbnail font/style effect is unmeasurable until fonts are tagged per video in adm-upload-state.json.
